section_summary.extract_value: This section (3.2.2) presents results on body satisfaction as assessed by a daily version of the Body Image States Scale. The analysis examined between-persons and within-persons predictors of body satisfaction, finding that daily deviation in exposure to non-body focused others was a positive predictor of body satisfaction, while exposure to body focused others was not significant. A second model examined changes in exposure from the previous day, showing that increases in exposure to non-body focused others predicted better body satisfaction.
